acceptance: The code, its pinning test and the operator message state the real coverage (ubuntu yes, macOS no).
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: an operator message and a pinned test state a false belief about CI coverage, which misleads failure triage
summary: The gate code and a test pin the claim that real-tmux tests are NOT covered by CI and name a loop-boot backstop that does not exist; operators are told local failures may correspond to no CI failure. Main CI run 36295274594 shows execTmux 100% covered on both ubuntu jobs and 0% on macOS.
title: Gate code claims the real-tmux tests are not covered by CI; the ubuntu jobs do run them
